scope: The complete 305-token postav-containing census in the four Latin sources after EDIT-0115: 204 formal-assumption sites in 53 surface forms and 101 protected unprefixed postav- controls.
choice: Normalize all 27 imperfective formal-assumption verbs to official type-1 prědpokladati forms; normalize 23 perfective verbs, 56 -ka assumption nouns, 67 -jenje supposition nouns and 31 passive/adjectival forms to official type-1 prědpolož- forms; preserve productive ne- in the one negative passive form; and repair the ten agreement tokens required when seven source phrases change from feminine -ka nouns to neuter prědpoloženje.
motivation: Every selected context denotes mathematical assumption, hypothesis, supposition or presupposition. The official-looking prědpostavjati entry is a type-3 false friend meaning prefer. EDIT-0043 already established the aspect-preserving prědpoklad-/prědpolož- house split. The edition has no bare prědpoklad noun controls but has an established prědpoloženj- noun family, so prědpoloženje avoids a new noun doublet and has the broader official branch profile.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining predpostav-/prědpostav-/předpostav- was rejected because it leaves a mixed unaccented, South-shaped and Czech-shaped source layer adjacent to an official type-3 false friend meaning prefer.
A blind stem swap was rejected because -ka nouns require lemma, gender and case recasts, while imperfective -avja/-avlja verbs require prědpoklad- rather than prědpolož-.
Mapping the whole family to prědpoklad- was rejected because it destroys perfective, passive and verbal-noun morphology.
Mapping the whole family to prědpolož- was rejected because it destroys the imperfective aspect family.
Official prědpolagati was rejected as an edition doublet under the controlling EDIT-0043 policy.
Bare noun prědpoklad was rejected because it would introduce an unattested edition noun doublet and has weaker branch recognition than prědpoloženje.
Uslovje was rejected because condition is not equivalent to every formal assumption or supposition in these contexts.
Domněvati and mněti were rejected because opinion or thinking is not the formal mathematical premise relation here.
The 101 unprefixed postav- controls were preserved because they mean put, set, formulate or establish, not assume.

evidence.semantic_audit: All 204 sites were inspected in sentence context. Exact partition: 27 imperfective verbs, 23 perfective verbs, 56 -ka nouns, 67 -jenje-family nouns and 31 passive/adjectival forms. No prefer, physical-put, title, citation-identity or foreign-literal sense occurs.
evidence.complete_census: A Unicode-wide census of every word token containing postav finds 305: exactly 204 selected prefixed assumption-family tokens and 101 protected unprefixed controls. Prefix split is 179 pred-/nepred-, 24 prěd- and one Czech před-. No pret-, pręd-, przed- or other prefixed assumption shape remains.

locator_receipt.algorithm: For each file in order 44-book, 45, base, bib, scan each line with Unicode-aware whole-word regex (?i)(?:ne)?(?:predpostav|prědpostav|předpostav)\w* and serialize filename<TAB>line<TAB>column<TAB>token<TAB>full-line<LF>.

evidence.protected_domains: All 204 targets are running prose outside comments and math and outside foreign, foreignlanguage, URL, href, label, ref, pageref, eqref and cite payloads. The 101 unprefixed controls and all pre-existing canonical prědpoklad-/prědpolož- tokens are preserved except where explicitly targeted by a whole phrase.
evidence.independent_qa: A separate read-only reviewer independently found the initially missed Czech předpostavka, required its neuter agreement recast, then reproduced the final 204-site/53-form census, all seven phrase recasts, output hashes, zero residue, official/German evidence and structural/protected-domain gates and returned ACCEPT with no remaining defect. A second independent audit reproduced the 305-token broad census and 204/101 semantic split.

mapping_policy.imperfective: predpostavja-/predpostavlja-/prědpostavlja- -> prědpoklada- with inflection and capitalization preserved
mapping_policy.ka_nouns: predpostavka/prědpostavka/předpostavka paradigm -> neuter prědpoloženje paradigm with case/number preserved and sentence agreement repaired
mapping_policy.negative: nepredpostavjenu -> neprědpoloženu, preserving productive negation and feminine accusative agreement
